## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-OFF confirmed; Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: Defensives (JNJ, PG) ABOVE TREND and Financials + Industrials are both negative, supporting the RISK-OFF call; Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Materials lead: NEM (1W: +8.84% | 1M: +18.53%) ABOVE TREND; Energy strong: SLB (1W: +5.54% | 1M: +28.23%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +4.52% | 1M: +14.24%) ABOVE TREND; Consumer Staples holding: PG (1W: +4.55% | 1M: +5.98%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Real Estate weak (1W: -2.25%) showing sector weakness; Financials lag: MS (1W: -6.40% | 1M: -0.42%) BELOW TREND and JPM (1W: -3.73% | 1M: -7.44%) BELOW TREND; Industrials weak: GE (1W: -8.15% | 1M: -6.52%) BELOW TREND and MMM (1W: -4.92% | 1M: +1.67%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: AMD (1W: +13.93% | 1M: +20.81%) ABOVE TREND, GILD (1W: +12.10% | 1M: +9.48%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +8.84% | 1M: +18.53%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +6.11% | 1M: -0.41%) RECOVERY, SLB (1W: +5.54% | 1M: +28.23%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: BK (1W: -4.71% | 1M: +0.74%) CORRECTION, MMM (1W: -4.92% | 1M: +1.67%) CORRECTION, GS (1W: -5.84% | 1M: +2.21%) CORRECTION, MS (1W: -6.40% | 1M: -0.42%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -6.68% | 1M: -10.46%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Financials and select Tech.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W momentum: AMD (1W: +13.93% | 1M: +20.81%) ABOVE TREND, GILD (1W: +12.10% | 1M: +9.48%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +8.84% | 1M: +18.53%) ABOVE TREND; note MAJOR divergence across large caps (MSFT, META, TSLA, GOOGL, INTC) — tactical watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech mixed and under pressure: AAPL (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -8.46%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: +2.03% | 1M: -3.91%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: +0.33% | 1M: +2.17%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: -6.68% | 1M: -10.46%) BELOW TREND — sector 1W: -0.45% with internal rotation and notable divergences.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials broadly underperforming: MS (1W: -6.40% | 1M: -0.42%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -5.84% | 1M: +2.21%) CORRECTION, BK (1W: -4.71% | 1M: +0.74%) CORRECTION — sector 1W: -1.94% and contributing to RISK-OFF.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare relatively defensive: UNH (1W: +5.10% | 1M: +9.56%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +6.18%) ABOVE TREND, ABT (1W: -13.04% | 1M: -13.77%) BELOW TREND — sector 1W: +0.56% with pockets of dispersion.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor defensive/quality names (JNJ, PG, UNH) and reduce exposure to beaten-up Financials and cyclical Industrials until trend repair; style: Defensive/Quality over Growth given RISK-OFF and weak Financials/Industrials confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +13.93% | 1M: +20.81%) ABOVE TREND for momentum follow-through, GILD (1W: +12.10% | 1M: +9.48%) ABOVE TREND on headline momentum. BEARISH: ABT (1W: -13.04% | 1M: -13.77%) BELOW TREND on earnings weakness, INTC (1W: -6.73% | 1M: +23.92%) CORRECTION on negative headlines.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Materials and Energy (Materials 1W: +2.12%, Energy 1W: +1.96%) as commodity-linked names show strength. BEARISH: Financials and Real Estate (Financials 1W: -1.94%, Real Estate 1W: -2.25%) — watch for continued outflows.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
AMD above-trend continuation if 1W momentum sustains near recent highs; NVDA holding short-term support with ABOVE TREND status; MS and GS break below 1W lows would deepen Financials weakness; ABT failure to stabilize is a clear downside trigger.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
GE (+50): headline on aerospace backlog, but GE (1W: -8.15% | 1M: -6.52%) BELOW TREND — sentiment vs price diverging. AVGO (+50): upgrade-driven sentiment while AVGO (1W: -6.70% | 1M: -6.27%) BELOW TREND — sentiment not yet confirmed by price.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
INTC (-55): negative headlines and INTC (1W: -6.73% | 1M: +23.92%) CORRECTION — sentiment confirmed and watch for follow-through. ABT (-55): earnings miss and ABT (1W: -13.04% | 1M: -13.77%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price aligned and at risk.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, Defensive/Quality style. JNJ (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +6.18%) ABOVE TREND and PG (1W: +4.55% | 1M: +5.98%) ABOVE TREND show relative strength while AMD (1W: +13.93% | 1M: +20.81%) ABOVE TREND is a momentum outlier. Major divergence among big caps (MSFT, META, INTC) and bearish headlines on INTC/ABT are key risks to monitor.
